result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with a marked zebra crosswalk and continuous sidewalks in good condition. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the intersection lacks advanced traffic calming measures or visible traffic control devices for the crossing.

hazards.name: Lack of intersection control
hazards.description: No stop sign or traffic signal is visible to control vehicle movement at the crosswalk approach.
hazards.location_in_image: Intersection approach on the right side of the image.

hazards.name: Wide turning radius
hazards.description: The corner geometry allows for relatively high-speed vehicle turns across the pedestrian path.
hazards.location_in_image: Corner curb near the fire hydrant.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce the crossing distance and slow down turning vehicles.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the crosswalk to sidewalk level to act as a speed table and increase pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with sidewalks and a marked zebra crosswalk across the side street. However, there is no marked crossing or traffic control visible for the main road, and large trees at the corner may obstruct sight lines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Unmarked Main Road Crossing
hazards.description: There is no designated or marked crossing for pedestrians to traverse the primary roadway shown in the foreground.

hazards.name: Vegetation Obstruction
hazards.description: A large evergreen tree at the corner obscures sight lines between pedestrians waiting to cross and motorists on the main road.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility zebra crosswalk across the main road to define a safe pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove or prune the large tree and other vegetation near the corner to ensure clear sight lines for all users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions at the intersection to reduce crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

result.summary: The image shows a two-lane road with a sidewalk on one side, adjacent to an institutional building behind a fence. While the sidewalk is in good condition, there are no marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, or traffic calming measures to facilitate safe crossing to the facility.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crosswalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians have no designated, protected space to cross the road to reach the institutional building.

hazards.name: Absence of traffic calming
hazards.description: The straight, wide roadway design may encourage high vehicle speeds, increasing risk for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Install high-visibility crosswalks
interventions.description: Provide a clearly marked path for pedestrians to cross the street.

interventions.title: Add pedestrian warning signage
interventions.description: Alert drivers to the potential presence of pedestrians near the institutional entrance.

interventions.title: Implement curb extensions
interventions.description: Reduce the crossing distance and improve visibility at potential crossing points.
